name: MoGe-2 Small (Metric Depth)
description: Monocular metric depth in meters from a single photo, indoors or outdoors, with the camera's field of view estimated as a by-product. MoGe-2 ViT-S (35M parameters) as the author-published ONNX export for ONNX Runtime. Two host-side steps are required (shift/focal solve and scale); a known focal length improves accuracy. See the README.
author: HereLiesAz

decode.meaning: affine point map in camera axes (x right, y down, z forward), same H and W as the input image; metric only after the shift and scale steps
decode.shift: least-squares fit of focal * points.xy / (points.z + shift) = uv on a 64x64 nearest-neighbour subsample of the pixels where mask > 0.5; uv = (pixel offset from the image centre) / (half the image diagonal in pixels)
decode.focalRelative: focal_px / (0.5 * hypot(width_px, height_px)); fixed when the camera focal length is known, otherwise fitted jointly with shift

decode.meaning: unit surface normals in camera axes; optional, not needed for depth
probability that a pixel has valid geometry (false for sky and unreliable regions)
the metric scale: multiplies (points.z + shift) to give meters
